declarations.name: FormShowIfElement
declarations.description: Light-DOM conditional form fields. Unmatched managed fields are disabled and their wrapper is hidden unless disabled-class supplies author-controlled visibility. No colors, status strings, or focus changes are generated.

members.name: conditions
members.description: OR-separated name=value conditions. * matches a nonempty value. Null removes the attribute; no matching condition disables the managed fields.

members.name: disabledClass
members.description: A single authored class token applied to the wrapper when unavailable, instead of setting hidden. Managed fields remain natively disabled.

members.name: enabledClass
members.description: A single authored class token applied when available. Alone, it does not replace native hiding when unavailable.

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: OR-separated name=value comparisons, with * for any nonempty value. Missing names do not match. Conditions use current values, not the controller's enabled state.

attributes.name: disabled-class
attributes.description: A single class token used instead of hidden on the unavailable wrapper. Native disabling still excludes managed fields from submission.

attributes.name: enabled-class
attributes.description: A single class token for the available wrapper. Does not replace hidden when disabled-class is absent.

modules.description: Importing this module calls the guarded definition helper automatically.

declarations.name: defineFormShowIf
declarations.description: Registers the class when a browser custom-elements registry exists. Returns false without a registry, otherwise true. Existing registrations are retained.
